name: Olly
source:
Olly is a dryad who met Dale when darkness fell.

Like other dryads, Olly is caring for her part of the forest.

She is easily influenced by corruption.

She acts foolish and absent minded at times. Sometimes she loses her memories about some things. Partly it happens because of corruption.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1933372300/forest-fortress-live2d-animated-novel]Kickstarter campaign[/url]]
